coordinate_system: glTF Y-up, right-handed. Screen at z~-1.25; audience at more negative Z. Seats face +Z (toward the screen). Viewer's right is -X. Three.js camera: use lookAt(screen centre); do not assume the default -Z forward.

units.note: ESTIMATE from seat width (1.28u ~ 0.55m). Distances in m are approximate.

eye_model.disclaimer: Geometric estimate for a seated adult. Not a measurement of a physical cinema. No obstruction (heads, rails) is modelled.
